title: Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and their Aggregate Economic Implications
title_zh: 对顶层财富征税：迁移反应及其总体经济影响
authors: Jakobsen, Katrine, Kleven, Henrik, Kolsrud, Jonas, Landais, Camille, Munoz, Mathilde
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using administrative data from Scandinavian countries, we provide evidence on international migration responses to wealth taxes and evaluate their aggregate economic implications. We find significant migration responses among the wealthy: a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate decreases the stock of wealthy taxpayers by about 2%. A large fraction of the wealthy are business owners, and their businesses are negatively affected by owner out-migration. The aggregate effects are nevertheless modest: the migration responses to a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate reduce employment by 0.02%, investments by 0.07%, and value-added by 0.10%.

title: ‘Identify the Expert’: an Experimental Study in Economic Advice
title_zh: 识别专家”：经济建议的实验研究
authors: Alysandratos, Theodore, Boukouras, Aris, Georganas, Sotiris, Maniadis, Zacharias
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In a novel ‘identify the Expert’ task, participants receive suggested answers by two advisors. They know one is high-accuracy and recommends answers reflecting the academic consensus (‘Expert’). The other is low-accuracy and recommends the modal answer from a sample of laypeople (‘Populist’). Participants are incentivized to identify the Expert. Yet, they overwhelmingly choose the Populist, even when they could always identify the Expert without using Bayesian reasoning. Overconfidence hampers decision making, but does not fully account for the low success rate. Bayesian models fail to explain these choices. These results are relevant for a wide range of expert selection problems.
abstract_zh: 在一项新颖的“识别专家”任务中，参与者会收到两位顾问提供的建议答案。他们知道其中一位准确率较高，且其推荐答案反映了学术共识（“专家”）；另一位准确率较低，推荐的是从普通民众样本中得出的众数答案（“民粹者”）。参与者被激励去识别专家。然而，他们绝大多数选择了民粹者，即便在不使用贝叶斯推理的情况下，他们本可以始终识别出专家。过度自信阻碍了决策，但并不能完全解释这种低成功率。贝叶斯模型无法解释这些选择。这些结果对广泛的专家选择问题具有启示意义。

title: Government Intervention in the Financial Market
title_zh: 政府对金融市场的干预
abstract: Abstract Government intervention in the financial market through its own trading fundamentally changes the market’s structure, function, and outcome. I develop a general equilibrium framework to study the impact of government trading on investor welfare. I show that with incompleteness and information asymmetry, the market equilibrium is in general suboptimal, and government intervention can potentially improve investor welfare even with no additional information. However, the actual welfare impact of government intervention is sensitive to the details of the economy and the policy design. Popular policy targets such as price stability, market liquidity, and informational efficiency can have different welfare implications.
abstract_zh: 摘要 政府通过自身交易对金融市场进行干预，从根本上改变了市场的结构、功能与结果。本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，研究政府交易对投资者福利的影响。研究表明，在市场不完备且存在信息不对称的情况下，市场均衡通常并非最优，即便政府不掌握额外信息，其干预也可能改善投资者福利。然而，政府干预的实际福利效应高度依赖于经济体的具体特征及政策设计。诸如价格稳定、市场流动性和信息效率等常见政策目标，可能对福利产生截然不同的影响。

title: Fiscal Multipliers during Natural Disasters
title_zh: 自然灾害期间的财政乘数
authors: Andreas Dibiasi, Céline Poilly, Erica Perego, Andreas Dibiasi; Céline Poilly; Erica Perego
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Fiscal multipliers are larger during natural disasters. Using aggregate and state-level U.S. data, we show that the government-spending multiplier is significantly magnified when natural disasters occur. To rationalize this finding, we develop a New-Keynesian model augmented with disaster risk, in which higher public spending generates a larger output expansion through a strengthened investment channel. Two mechanisms are at work. First, by destroying productive capacity, a disaster raises the marginal productivity of capital, which further crowds in private investment. Second, wealth destruction leads households to draw down less of their savings in response to the fiscal shock, which boosts capital supply.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害期间财政乘数显著增大。基于美国全国及州级数据，我们发现当自然灾害发生时，政府支出乘数会显著放大。为解释这一现象，我们构建了纳入灾害风险的新凯恩斯模型，其中公共支出通过强化投资渠道产生更大的产出扩张效应。两种机制在发挥作用：其一，灾害破坏生产能力后，资本边际生产率提升，进而挤出私人投资；其二，财富损失导致家庭在面临财政冲击时减少储蓄消耗，从而增加资本供给。

title: An Informational Rationale for Viewpoint Neutrality in Education
title_zh: 教育中观点中立的信息学理据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Consider a society that faces uncertainty about a payoff-relevant state and wants to train students to make correct decisions. In educational institutions, students learn from their teachers, but they also get outside information, and later learn from peers. We show that privately Bayesian actions need not be optimal inputs into social learning: when students' actions reflect teacher-side information that is correlated across peers, observing many such actions can give this information excessive social weight. A social planner may therefore optimally reduce the precision of instruction, inducing students to rely more on outside information before their actions become signals for others, and students can end up better informed despite learning less from their teachers. The case for a precision cap is stronger when peer interaction is homophilous, because same-teacher information is more likely to survive aggregation, and weaker when outside information is itself systematically distorted. This provides an informational rationale for viewpoint neutrality as an institutional policy: it limits the social overrepresentation of correlated teacher-side information when students mostly learn from peers exposed to similar sources.
abstract_zh: 考虑一个面临与收益相关状态不确定性的社会，其目标是培养学生做出正确决策。在教育机构中，学生从教师处学习，同时获取外部信息，并随后向同伴学习。研究表明，贝叶斯私人行动未必是社会学习的最优输入：当学生的行动反映了教师侧信息，且该信息在同伴间存在相关性时，观察大量此类行动可能导致该信息在社会层面被过度加权。因此，社会规划者可能最优地降低教学精度，促使学生在自身行动成为他人信号之前更多地依赖外部信息，最终学生虽从教师处学得更少，却能获得更充分的信息。当同伴互动呈现同质性时，支持精度上限的理由更为充分，因为源自同一教师的信息更易在聚合过程中存续；而当外部信息本身存在系统性偏差时，该理由则相对较弱。这为作为制度政策的观点中立性提供了信息层面的理论依据：当学生主要向接触相似信息来源的同伴学习时，该政策能够限制教师侧相关信息在社会层面的过度表征。

title: Helicopter drops in an open economy when markets are incomplete
title_zh: 不完全市场下开放经济中的直升机撒钱
abstract: Abstract We characterize the spillover effects of helicopter drops and optimal monetary policy in a tractable two‐country overlapping generations model with incomplete markets. As helicopter drops can affect the distribution of income across countries, they create room for redistribution policies which are particularly relevant when agents are heterogeneous and markets are incomplete. Under cooperation, central banks can implement the conditionally Pareto optimal allocation using helicopter drops (and suctions) to “lean against the wind.” In a non‐cooperative setting, helicopter drops exacerbate the incomplete markets' friction by making income more volatile. This paves the way for gains from cooperation.
abstract_zh: 摘要：本文在一个可处理的两国世代交叠模型（含不完全市场）中，刻画了直升机撒钱的溢出效应及最优货币政策。由于直升机撒钱可能影响国家间的收入分配，这为再分配政策创造了空间——当经济主体存在异质性且市场不完全时，此类政策尤为重要。在合作框架下，央行可通过直升机撒钱（及抽钱）实施条件帕累托最优配置，实现“逆风干预”。在非合作框架下，直升机撒钱会加剧收入波动，从而放大不完全市场的摩擦，这为合作收益的产生奠定了基础。

title: Elite Universities and the Intergenerational Transmission of Human and Social Capital
title_zh: 精英大学与人力资本和社会资本的代际传递
authors: Andrés Barrios-Fernández, Christopher Neilson, Seth Zimmerman
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do elite colleges help talented students join the social elite or help incumbent elites retain their positions? We combine intergenerationally linked data from Chile with a regression discontinuity design to show that, looking across generations, elite colleges do both. Lower-status individuals who gain admission to elite college programs transform their children’s social environment. Children become more likely to attend high-status private schools and colleges and to live near and befriend high-status peers. In contrast, academic achievement is unaffected. Simulations combining descriptive and quasi-experimental findings show that elite colleges tighten the link between social and human capital while decreasing intergenerational social mobility. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13)

title: Do Mutual Funds Walk the Talk? Evidence from Fund Risk Disclosure
title_zh: 共同基金是否言行一致？来自基金风险披露的证据
authors: Jinfei Sheng, Nan Xu, Lu Zheng
abstract: Abstract We examine the informativeness of fund risk disclosure by combining fund returns and textual data. We develop a novel measure, INF, to capture the explanatory power of disclosed risks for fund returns. Average INF is 55% after controlling for market risk and remains 26–29% after excluding risks related to fund name or strategy. We explain variations in INF through disclosure costs and benefits: (1) Funds with less informative disclosures face SEC comment letters and reduced flow, (2) informative disclosures attract institutional flows, and (3) performance concerns may disincentivize disclosure. Overall, funds face trade-offs between transparency and maintaining their competitive advantage. (JEL G12)
